entries.title: Ron/gm Based Design Methodology for Dynamic Amplifiers
entries.desc: Novel design methodology for inverter-based non-linear dynamic amplifiers. Models RC, large-signal, and small-signal settling stages; validated on an inverter-based switched-capacitor amplifier in IHP SG13G2 using open-source EDA tools.

entries.title: Analog CMOS Multiplier Circuits: Design and Comparative Analysis
entries.desc: Design and comparison of analog multiplier circuits for low-power pre-ADC sensor processing, power management, and analog neural networks using translinear and linear MOSFET-based MAC architectures.

entries.title: Sub-5 ppm/°C Piecewise-Compensated Bandgap Reference
entries.desc: High-PSRR Bandgap Reference with piecewise curvature compensation and a low-power always-on startup circuit, designed in SKY130 at IIT Gandhinagar LP-CAS Lab. Fabricated through the TinyTapeout 10 SKY130 shuttle.
